turns.patient_opening: I’m a 102-year-old man. For the last… not sure exactly, but it started fairly quickly, and I’ve had upper chest pain with burning and sensitive pain, plus a sore throat and nasal congestion with a clear runny nose. I also have a cough that brings up colored or more sputum than usual, I feel quite short of breath, and I’ve noticed wheezing when I exhale.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel any pain somewhere in your upper middle abdomen (the area just below your breastbone)?
turns.patient_answer: No, it’s not in my upper middle abdomen. The pain is mainly in my upper chest, and it also feels like my throat—my right and left breast area both hurt too.

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have a fever—either that you feel (hot/flushed) or that you’ve measured with a thermometer?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t think I have a fever, and I haven’t measured one with a thermometer.

turns.doctor_question: Do your skin lesions peel off or flake away (for example, like skin shedding)?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any skin peeling or flaking.

turns.doctor_question: What color is the rash (for example: red, pink, pale, dark, or yellow)? If there isn’t a rash, you can say “absent.”
